items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: That happened in a Benny Carter session actually with Kenny Washington playing drums.

ctx.x: So if you get in front of a high school band and they have those drum parts that are so – there’s way too much in them, and the poor drummers are trying to hit everything and you just take the music away.

Yeah. That happened in a Benny Carter session actually with Kenny Washington playing drums. And he was trying to do that, get all the hits. And I think at some point Benny Carter got frustrated with him and said, “Don’t bother with all that nonsense, just play the drums. Just play the drums. Just lay out a rhythm. That’s all I need.” It’s interesting stuff.
What’s on your desert island playlist?
